about: Boss weapons (Dom + Strategy 2026-10-28): the weapon a boss of a V1 archetype (`opponent`) fights with and is drawn with. Boss 2 Gargantua is the executioner and wields a MAUL; boss 3 Arachne is the shieldmaiden and wields an AXE in one hand and a SHIELD in the other. Before this a foe's weapon was V1's row for its archetype (the executioner's scythe, the shieldmaiden's gladius). A zone spawn's kind (data/profiles.json, src/fight/spawn-kind.ts kindFightFor) whose `opponent` has a row here fights with `weapon` (a src/fight/weapon-defs.json row: its moves, reach, damage, timing, and V1's hero-rig blade sweeps for it, data/fight.json bladeTables) and is drawn with the same weapon (src/fight/boss-hand.ts, scene.ts). The archetype's guard, stats, specials and AI are untouched, so the shieldmaiden keeps her shield guard and the shield is the drawing of it. `clipsAs`: a 106 body carries no Maul_* or Scythe_* clips, so it plays this weapon's clip family (the sword family, as the Pitborn's cleaver does) until the bodies land with their own. `equip`: the grafted part, a file under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (the Pitborn's cleaver, no new file). `scale`: the drawn part scaled about its grip (the closest existing mesh, scaled: NO new art in this row set; Strategy). `offhand`: a part on the other hand (null = none); kind `disc` is a flat round board built in code (no file) sized in METRES in world space (`radius`, `thickness`), seated on `hand` at `offset` metres with `rotationDeg` Euler XYZ in that bone's frame. MOUNTING knobs (2026-10-28): `equip` is the part's file stem under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (to drop in an OpenTrident GLB: put the file there, add its one-line URL to FOE_EQUIP_URLS in src/fight/scene.ts and the stem to PACKED in scripts/build.mjs, name it here); `scale` grows the DRAWN part about its grip (the grafted node under the Grip106 seat; before, the socket bone was scaled, which moved nothing drawn); `grip` {offset metres, rotationDeg Euler XYZ} nudges the drawn part in the seat frame (the sim's reach is V1's blade tables and is untouched); `material` {colour, metalness, roughness} replaces the part's own look (null = the file's; the Pitborn's cleaver is near-black and vanished against Arachne's dark legs, so the placeholder wears iron grey). The shield `offhand` is parented to `hand` (lowerarm_l); its board axis (the face normal) is the board's local Y rotated by `rotationDeg` in the forearm's frame: on a Mixamo left forearm Y runs elbow to wrist, -Z is the back of the forearm (away from the palm), so rotationDeg [-90,0,0] puts the face outward and `offset` [0, 0.14, -0.07] seats it between elbow and wrist with a small gap (radius, thickness, offset, rotationDeg are the tuning knobs; scripts/boss-walkin-stills.mjs METRIC=1 prints the clearance to head and chest). `placeholder`: exactly what is a stand-in, so nobody mistakes it for art. Presentation and the sim's weapon id only; the archetype's other rows are untouched. ?bossweapon=v1 puts every boss back on V1's weapon (and the drawn part); ?bossweapon=<opponent id> (stills) draws that row's weapon on the page's own foe (the Minotaur body) without changing the sim. Rows are checked by src/sim/validate.js (keys) and src/fight/boss-weapon.ts validateBossWeapons (values), at load.
